description: This file implements the SystemTime class, which manages system time status, timezone information, and event handling via JSON-RPC communication in a plugin environment. It includes methods for subscribing to time events, updating time status and timezone, parsing timezone transitions, and handling event loops.

classes.name: SystemTime
classes.description: Manages system time status, timezone info, and event subscriptions within a plugin framework.

methods.name: CreateSystemLink
methods.description: Creates a JSON-RPC link to the system service, including security token generation.

methods.name: SubscribeForEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to time status and timezone change events via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: UpdateTimeStatus
methods.description: Retrieves and updates the current system time quality status.

methods.name: UpdateTimeZone
methods.description: Retrieves and updates timezone and accuracy information.

methods.name: ParseTimeZone
methods.description: Parses timezone transition data to determine current offset.

methods.name: PopulateTimeZoneTransitionMap
methods.description: Populates timezone transition map by parsing 'zdump' command output.

methods.name: EventLoop
methods.description: Main loop processing queued events for time status and timezone updates.
